title: Quality-of-Life Management for COPD Patients
brief_summary: The investigators aim to investigate the effects of a telemonitoring and chatbot-based application of "Living well with COPD" (CAir) on health-related quality-of-life in patients with COPD.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

• Diagnosed COPD according to GOLD-guidelines

Exclusion Criteria:

* Physical or intellectual impairment precluding informed consent or protocol adherence
* Non-German speaking
* Acute or recent (within the last 6 weeks) exacerbation of COPD
* Attending a pulmonary rehabilitation program within the last 3 months
* Pregnant patients
